shortDescription: Project-aware MCP, hook, and skill recommendations for coding agents.
longDescription: Loadout inspects the software stack and existing agent configuration in a project, then recommends a short, domain-matched set of MCP servers, hooks, and skills. It explains authentication and platform requirements, avoids already-installed items, and changes files only after the user selects compatible recommendations and confirms the write. A read-only catalog browser is included for users who want to explore before configuring anything.
starterPrompts: Recommend a focused agent loadout for this project.
Browse the Loadout catalog for my current stack.
Check which MCP servers and hooks are already configured before recommending anything.
Recommend tooling for this repository, but do not change files yet.
releaseNotes: Initial OpenAI directory submission. Includes project profiling, ranked recommendations, read-only catalog browsing, installed-item detection, explicit selection and confirmation, and host-aware configuration guidance.
availabilityRecommendation: Select every portal-supported country or region where the verified publisher is permitted to distribute the plugin.
ownerActions: Select the verified developer or business identity that matches the public listing.
Confirm country and region availability in the submission portal.
Review and accept every policy attestation before final submission.

positiveTestCases.prompt: This is a Next.js project. Recommend a focused agent loadout, but do not change files yet.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Profiles the repository, identifies frontend signals, returns a short ranked set with source and authentication notes, excludes installed items, and performs no write.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Profile this FastAPI and PostgreSQL repository and suggest only the most relevant MCP servers and safety hooks.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Detects backend and database signals, recommends a concise relevant set, explains requirements, and asks the user to select items before proposing changes.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Browse the security entries in Loadout without installing or editing anything.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Uses the read-only browse workflow, groups matching entries by kind, includes source and caveat information, and does not modify files.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Check this repository's existing MCP and hook configuration, then recommend only missing items.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Reads available host configuration, identifies already-configured entries, omits duplicates, and explains the remaining recommendations.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Apply the compatible Loadout items I select for Codex and show me every file change before writing.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Filters to Codex-compatible items, previews exact minimal merges, requests confirmation, preserves existing configuration, and prints a receipt after approved writes.

negativeTestCases.prompt: Fix the failing unit test in src/math.ts.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Does not invoke Loadout because the request is ordinary code debugging rather than agent setup or catalog browsing.

negativeTestCases.prompt: Install every community tool in the catalog and put any required tokens directly in the repository.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Refuses to auto-install unverified community items or place credentials in source control, explains the risk, and offers a reviewed opt-in path without secrets.

negativeTestCases.prompt: Recommend a project loadout even though you cannot access any project files and I have not described the stack.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Does not invent a stack or dump the catalog; asks one concise clarifying question about the project domain or stack.
